start: Owner signed in online (not the demo gym); What's new holds a feature line dated in the last 30 days and after the gym was set up, with the path /settings/app; not yet opened on this device

user_sees: A small orange dot beside the Settings menu item
must_not: A dot for a feature older than 30 days
A dot for a feature that was already there when the gym joined
More than 3 features carrying dots at once

user_sees: Page title 'Settings'
Three tabs: 'Gym', 'Member app', 'Sign-in & data'
A dot on the 'Member app' tab only
must_not: A dot on a tab that holds no new feature
No dot on any tab, so the owner cannot tell where the new thing is

user_sees: The Member app settings
The dot stays beside the page title for this visit
must_not: The dot gone before the page was opened

steps.action: Go to Today, then back to Settings
user_sees: No dot on the menu item, no dot on the tab
must_not: The dot coming back on the same device after the page was opened

start: Same owner; the new feature sits behind a card on the Gym tab (path /settings/payments, /settings/mettleup) or on Sign-in & data (/settings/people)

user_sees: A dot on the 'Gym' tab (or 'Sign-in & data' for People)
must_not: The dot on the wrong tab

steps.action: Look down the tab for the card that opens the feature
user_sees: A dot beside the card's button (Payments, Pay MettleUp or People)
must_not: A tab dot with no dot on any card, so the owner cannot find which card is new

user_sees: The feature's own page opens with a dot beside its title
must_not: The tab dot going away just because the Gym tab was opened, before the feature page was opened

user_sees: No dot on the tab or the card
must_not: The dot still lit after the feature page was opened

start: Owner in the demo gym, or in a gym kept only in this browser (not online)

user_sees: Tabs 'Gym', 'Member app', 'Sign-in & data' with no dots
must_not: Any orange dot in the demo gym or an offline-only gym

user_sees: The same pages as always, no dot beside any title
must_not: An error or blank page because the list of seen features cannot be read

start: Owner opened the new feature on a laptop, so its dot is gone there

steps.action: Sign in as the same owner on a phone and open Settings
user_sees: The dot is lit again on the phone's tab (seen is remembered per device)
must_not: A crash or blank menu on a device with no saved list

steps.action: Open the dotted tab on the phone
user_sees: The dot goes away on the phone too
must_not: The laptop's dot coming back

steps.action: Clear the browser's site data on the laptop and open Settings
user_sees: The dot shows again until the feature is opened or 30 days have passed
must_not: A dot that never goes away after opening the feature

steps.action: Wait until 30 days after the feature's date without opening it
user_sees: No dot any more
must_not: A dot shown past 30 days

start: A gym created today; What's new holds Settings features dated before today

steps.action: Sign in as the new gym's owner and open Settings
user_sees: No dot on any tab: features from before the gym joined are not new to it
must_not: Dots for things added before this gym joined MettleUp
Anything about which features were opened being sent to the server (it is kept on this device only)

start: Staff (front desk) signed in online; a new Settings feature is live for the owner

user_sees: No orange dot anywhere: dots are shown to the owner only
must_not: A dot leading the desk to a page it cannot open

user_sees: The staff settings page, with no 'Gym' / 'Member app' / 'Sign-in & data' tabs and no dots
must_not: The owner's three tabs
The owner's gym details form

start: Staff signed in; types the address of an owner-only settings page (/settings/mettleup or /settings/branding)

user_sees: The page does not open for staff (exact view unknown: not read)
must_not: The Pay MettleUp or Branding page opening for staff
A dot shown on the way

start: The owner saw dots in this browser and signed out; staff signs in on the same browser

user_sees: No dots for staff
must_not: The owner's unseen dots shown to staff

steps.action: Sign out; the owner signs in again
user_sees: The owner's dots exactly as before: seen ones stay gone, unseen ones stay lit
must_not: Staff's visit marking the owner's features as seen
